intro: Blue Ghost Mission 1 was Firefly Aerospace's first Moon landing, flown for NASA with ten instruments. After a nine-minute braking burn and a slow final descent on its thrusters, it touched down upright in Mare Crisium, near Mons Latreille, on 2 March 2025, within its 100 m target. It worked for more than 14 days, through a full lunar day, and returned more than 119 GB of data.
